versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְהֵ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶֽת־כָּל־עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.
controles.kjv: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the Lord hath commanded, that ye should do them.
controles.livre: E Moisés fez juntar toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, e disse-lhes: Estas são as coisas que o SENHOR mandou que façais.

versos.hebraico: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה ב֛וֹ מְלָאכָ֖ה יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: ‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to Yahweh: whoever does any work in it shall be put to death.
controles.kjv: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the Lord: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
controles.livre: Seis dias se fará obra, mas o dia sétimo vos será santo, sábado de repouso ao SENHOR: qualquer um que nele fizer obra morrerá.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תְבַעֲר֣וּ אֵ֔שׁ בְּכֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּי֖וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃פ

controles.web: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations on the Sabbath day.’”
controles.kjv: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
controles.livre: Não acendereis fogo em todas as vossas moradas no dia do sábado.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־כָּל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Moses spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded, saying,
controles.kjv: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying,
controles.livre: E falou Moisés a toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Isto é o que o SENHOR mandou, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: קְח֨וּ מֵֽאִתְּכֶ֤ם תְּרוּמָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כֹּ֚ל נְדִ֣יב לִבּ֔וֹ יְבִיאֶ֕הָ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֖סֶף וּנְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: ‘Take from among you an offering to Yahweh. Whoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, Yahweh’s offering: gold, silver, brass,
controles.kjv: Take ye from among you an offering unto the Lord: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the Lord; gold, and silver, and brass,
controles.livre: Tomai dentre vós oferta para o SENHOR: todo generoso de coração a trará ao SENHOR: ouro, prata, bronze;

versos.hebraico: וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ וְעִזִּֽים׃

controles.web: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,
controles.kjv: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
controles.livre: E azul, e púrpura, e carmesim, e linho fino, e pelo de cabras;

versos.hebraico: וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים וַעֲצֵ֥י שִׂטִּֽים׃

controles.web: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,
controles.kjv: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
controles.livre: E couros vermelhos de carneiros, e couros finos, e madeira de acácia;

versos.hebraico: וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לַמָּא֑וֹר וּבְשָׂמִים֙ לְשֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃

controles.web: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,
controles.kjv: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
controles.livre: E azeite para a luminária, e especiarias aromáticas para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático;

versos.hebraico: וְאַ֨בְנֵי־שֹׁ֔הַם וְאַבְנֵ֖י מִלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפ֖וֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

controles.web: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.
controles.kjv: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
controles.livre: E pedras de ônix, e demais pedrarias, para o éfode, e para o peitoral.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־חֲכַם־לֵ֖ב בָּכֶ֑ם יָבֹ֣אוּ וְיַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “‘Let every wise-hearted man among you come, and make all that Yahweh has commanded:
controles.kjv: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the Lord hath commanded;
controles.livre: E todo sábio de coração dentre vós, virá e fará todas as coisas que o SENHOR mandou:

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַ֨מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן אֶֽת־אָהֳל֖וֹ וְאֶת־מִכְסֵ֑הוּ אֶת־קְרָסָיו֙ וְאֶת־קְרָשָׁ֔יו אֶת־בְּרִיחָ֕ו אֶת־עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת־אֲדָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: the tabernacle, its outer covering, its roof, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, and its sockets;
controles.kjv: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
controles.livre: O tabernáculo, sua tenda, e sua coberta, e seus anéis, e suas tábuas, suas barras, suas colunas, e suas bases;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הָאָרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו אֶת־הַכַּפֹּ֑רֶת וְאֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַמָּסָֽךְ׃

controles.web: the ark, and its poles, the mercy seat, the veil of the screen;
controles.kjv: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
controles.livre: A arca, e suas varas, o propiciatório, e o véu da tenda;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־הַשֻּׁלְחָ֥ן וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃

controles.web: the table with its poles and all its vessels, and the show bread;
controles.kjv: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
controles.livre: A mesa, e suas varas, e todos os seus utensílios, e o pão da proposição.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־מְנֹרַ֧ת הַמָּא֛וֹר וְאֶת־כֵּלֶ֖יהָ וְאֶת־נֵרֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֥מֶן הַמָּאֽוֹר׃

controles.web: the lamp stand also for the light, with its vessels, its lamps, and the oil for the light;
controles.kjv: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
controles.livre: O candelabro da luminária, e seus utensílios, e suas lâmpadas, e o azeite para a luminária;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַקְּטֹ֨רֶת֙ וְאֶת־בַּדָּ֔יו וְאֵת֙ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת קְטֹ֣רֶת הַסַּמִּ֑ים וְאֶת־מָסַ֥ךְ הַפֶּ֖תַח לְפֶ֥תַח הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: and the altar of incense with its poles, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door, at the door of the tabernacle;
controles.kjv: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
controles.livre: E o altar do incenso, e suas varas, e o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático, e a cortina da porta, para a entrada do tabernáculo;

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ת׀ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֗ה וְאֶת־מִכְבַּ֤ר הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ אֶת־בַּדָּ֖יו וְאֶת־כָּל־כֵּלָ֑יו אֶת־הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־כַּנּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: the altar of burnt offering, with its grating of brass, it poles, and all its vessels, the basin and its base;
controles.kjv: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
controles.livre: O altar do holocausto, e sua grelha de bronze, e suas varas, e todos os seus utensílios, e a pia com sua base;

versos.hebraico: אֵ֚ת קַלְעֵ֣י הֶחָצֵ֔ר אֶת־עַמֻּדָ֖יו וְאֶת־אֲדָנֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֕ת מָסַ֖ךְ שַׁ֥עַר הֶחָצֵֽר׃

controles.web: the hangings of the court, its pillars, their sockets, and the screen for the gate of the court;
controles.kjv: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
controles.livre: As cortinas do átrio, suas colunas, e suas bases, e a cortina da porta do átrio;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־יִתְדֹ֧ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְאֶת־יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר וְאֶת־מֵיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: the pins of the tabernacle, the pins of the court, and their cords;
controles.kjv: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
controles.livre: As estacas do tabernáculo, e as estacas do átrio, e suas cordas;

versos.hebraico: אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י הַשְּׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃

controles.web: the finely worked garments, for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.’”
controles.kjv: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.
controles.livre: As vestimentas dos serviço para ministrar no santuário, as sagradas vestimentas de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestimentas de seus filhos para servir no sacerdócio.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּֽצְא֛וּ כָּל־עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִלִּפְנֵ֥י מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: All the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
controles.kjv: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
controles.livre: E saiu toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel de diante de Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ כָּל־אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֑וֹ וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נָדְבָ֨ה רוּח֜וֹ אֹת֗וֹ הֵ֠בִיאוּ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה לִמְלֶ֨אכֶת אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּלְכָל־עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ וּלְבִגְדֵ֖י הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: They came, everyone whose heart stirred him up, and everyone whom his spirit made willing, and brought Yahweh’s offering, for the work of the Tent of Meeting, and for all of its service, and for the holy garments.
controles.kjv: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the Lord’s offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
controles.livre: E veio todo homem a quem seu coração estimulou, e todo aquele a quem seu espírito lhe deu vontade, e trouxeram oferta ao SENHOR para a obra do tabernáculo do testemunho, e para toda sua confecção, e para as sagradas vestimentas.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים עַל־הַנָּשִׁ֑ים כֹּ֣ל׀ נְדִ֣יב לֵ֗ב הֵ֠בִיאוּ חָ֣ח וָנֶ֜זֶם וְטַבַּ֤עַת וְכוּמָז֙ כָּל־כְּלִ֣י זָהָ֔ב וְכָל־אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵנִ֛יף תְּנוּפַ֥ת זָהָ֖ב לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the Lord.
controles.livre: E vieram tanto homens como mulheres, todo voluntário de coração, e trouxeram correntes e pendentes, anéis e braceletes, e toda joia de ouro; e qualquer um oferecia oferta de ouro ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־נִמְצָ֣א אִתּ֗וֹ תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ וְעִזִּ֑ים וְעֹרֹ֨ת אֵילִ֧ם מְאָדָּמִ֛ים וְעֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים הֵבִֽיאוּ׃

controles.web: Everyone, with whom was found blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair, rams’ skins dyed red, and sea cow hides, brought them.
controles.kjv: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers’ skins, brought them.
controles.livre: Todo homem que se achava com material azul, ou púrpura, ou carmesim, ou linho fino, ou pelo de cabras, ou odres vermelhos de carneiros, ou couros finos, o trazia.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־מֵרִ֗ים תְּר֤וּמַת כֶּ֨סֶף֙ וּנְחֹ֔שֶׁת הֵבִ֕יאוּ אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְכֹ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ נִמְצָ֨א אִתּ֜וֹ עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֛ים לְכָל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה הֵבִֽיאוּ׃

controles.web: Everyone who offered an offering of silver and brass brought Yahweh’s offering; and everyone, with whom was found acacia wood for any work of the service, brought it.
controles.kjv: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the Lord’s offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
controles.livre: Qualquer um que oferecia oferta de prata ou de bronze, trazia ao SENHOR a oferta: e todo o que se achava com madeira de acácia, trazia-a para toda a obra do serviço.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־אִשָּׁ֥ה חַכְמַת־לֵ֖ב בְּיָדֶ֣יהָ טָו֑וּ וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ מַטְוֶ֗ה אֶֽת־הַתְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וְאֶת־הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן אֶת־תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וְאֶת־הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃

controles.web: All the women who were wise-hearted spun with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen.
controles.kjv: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
controles.livre: Além disso todas as mulheres sábias de coração fiavam de suas mãos, e traziam o que haviam fiado: azul, ou púrpura, ou carmesim, ou linho fino.

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָשָׂ֥א לִבָּ֛ן אֹתָ֖נָה בְּחָכְמָ֑ה טָו֖וּ אֶת־הָעִזִּֽים׃

controles.web: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.
controles.kjv: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats’ hair.
controles.livre: E todas as mulheres cujo coração as levantou em sabedoria, fiaram pelos de cabras.

versos.hebraico: וְהַנְּשִׂאִ֣ם הֵבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֚ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם וְאֵ֖ת אַבְנֵ֣י הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים לָאֵפ֖וֹד וְלַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

controles.web: The rulers brought the onyx stones, and the stones to be set, for the ephod and for the breastplate;
controles.kjv: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
controles.livre: E os príncipes trouxeram pedras de ônix, e as pedras dos engastes para o éfode e o peitoral;

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־הַבֹּ֖שֶׂם וְאֶת־הַשָּׁ֑מֶן לְמָא֕וֹר וּלְשֶׁ֨מֶן֙ הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְלִקְטֹ֖רֶת הַסַּמִּֽים׃

controles.web: and the spice, and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
controles.kjv: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
controles.livre: E a especiaria aromática e azeite, para a luminária, e para o azeite da unção, e para o incenso aromático.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֣ב לִבָּם֮ אֹתָם֒ לְהָבִיא֙ לְכָל־הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֑ה הֵבִ֧יאוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל נְדָבָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃פ

controles.web: The children of Israel brought a freewill offering to Yahweh; every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which Yahweh had commanded to be made by Moses.
controles.kjv: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the Lord, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the Lord had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Israel, tanto homens como mulheres, todos os que tiveram coração voluntário para trazer para toda a obra, que o SENHOR havia mandado por meio de Moisés que fizessem, trouxeram oferta voluntária ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רְא֛וּ קָרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה בְּשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, Yahweh has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the Lord hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
controles.livre: E disse Moisés aos filhos de Israel: Olhai, o SENHOR nomeou a Bezalel filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá;

versos.hebraico: וַיְמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה בִּתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל־מְלָאכָֽה׃

controles.web: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;
controles.kjv: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
controles.livre: E o encheu de espírito de Deus, em sabedoria, em inteligência, e em conhecimento, e em todo artifício,

versos.hebraico: וְלַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַֽחַשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשֹׂ֛ת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃

controles.web: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in brass,
controles.kjv: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
controles.livre: Para projetar inventos, para trabalhar em ouro, e em prata, e em bronze,

versos.hebraico: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכָל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת מַחֲשָֽׁבֶת׃

controles.web: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.
controles.kjv: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
controles.livre: E em obra de pedrarias para engastar, e em obra de madeira, para trabalhar em toda invenção engenhosa.

versos.hebraico: וּלְהוֹרֹ֖ת נָתַ֣ן בְּלִבּ֑וֹ ה֕וּא וְאָֽהֳלִיאָ֥ב בֶּן־אֲחִיסָמָ֖ךְ לְמַטֵּה־דָֽן׃

controles.web: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
controles.kjv: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
controles.livre: E pôs em seu coração o que podia ensinar, tanto ele como Aoliabe filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã:

versos.hebraico: מִלֵּ֨א אֹתָ֜ם חָכְמַת־לֵ֗ב לַעֲשׂוֹת֮ כָּל־מְלֶ֣אכֶת חָרָ֣שׁ׀ וְחֹשֵׁב֒ וְרֹקֵ֞ם בַּתְּכֵ֣לֶת וּבָֽאַרְגָּמָ֗ן בְּתוֹלַ֧עַת הַשָּׁנִ֛י וּבַשֵּׁ֖שׁ וְאֹרֵ֑ג עֹשֵׂי֙ כָּל־מְלָאכָ֔ה וְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י מַחֲשָׁבֹֽת׃

controles.web: He has filled them with wisdom of heart, to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.
controles.kjv: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
controles.livre: E os encheu de sabedoria de coração, para que façam toda obra de artifício, e de invenção, e de recamado em azul, e em púrpura, e em carmesim, e em linho fino, e em tear; para que façam todo trabalho, e inventem todo desenho.
